Ivy (Partnerships): Proposing a weekly SI certification office hours for the next month — focus weeks: marketplace listings, private/VPC onboarding, and hardware acceptance. Short 45min slots + 15min 1:1s. Thoughts?
Ken (SI Enablement): Good idea. Keeps momentum after the lab. Recommend a small prep checklist partners complete before joining.
Mira (HW Partnerships): I'll join hw weeks. Can we have an optional "kit preflight" drop-in during office hours for partners with HW issues?
Leo (Marketplace): Marketplace week: I'll run a 20m walkthrough + 20m live Q&A. We should share a sample manifest beforehand.
Ivy (Partnerships): Plan: Tuesdays 16:00 UTC for 4 weeks. Week1: marketplace, Week2: private/VPC, Week3: observability & rollback, Week4: HW deep-dive. OpsBot: calendar series created 2026-07-07 16:00 UTC.
Ken (SI Enablement): I'll create the prep checklist: sandbox access, API key (read-only), and sample app repo. Will post tomorrow.
Mira (HW Partnerships): For HW preflight, partners must run a tiny connectivity test and share kit serial. I'll draft the quicktest commands.
Leo (Marketplace): Also recommend short office-hour badges: attend + submit one evidence artifact -> small completion badge. Gives partners incentive.
Ivy (Partnerships): Love it. Action items: Ken -> checklist + signup form (due Fri); Mira -> kit preflight script (due Fri); Leo -> sample manifest + listing template (due Fri). OpsBot: reminders set 72h before first session.
Ken (SI Enablement): I'll also spin up a rotating Proctor rota; 2 internal leads per session.
Ivy (Partnerships): Great — if no objections we'll announce to selected SIs tomorrow. :rocket:
